fun_facts: J.J. McCarthy grew up in La Grange Park, outside Chicago.
He went 36-2 as a high-school starter at Nazareth Academy and IMG Academy.
He finished his Michigan career with a 27-1 record as a starter.
J.J. McCarthy helped lead Michigan to a 15-0 season and a national championship in 2023.
He became the first quarterback in NFL history to account for three touchdowns in the fourth quarter of his NFL debut.
He began meditating in high school and uses meditation as part of his pregame routine.
